content:
Velvet 2.0 is out: now based on Lean's most recent monadic verification verification machinery, easier to set up, and 10x faster. We've significantly increased the expressivity of Velvet, everything should feel much faster and intuitive. We've improved many of the papercuts we faced using it ourselves and based on user's feedback.

We also have a shiny new website at https://velvetprover.dev/ .

Release Notes: https://github.com/verse-lab/velvet/releases/tag/v2.0

Let us know if you face any difficulties using it.
